items.title: Chef Carrying a Turkey Platter Coloring Page
items.alt: A tall cartoon chef with a curled mustache carries roast turkey beside a stool topped with a pie in black outline.
items.description: A high toque, neckerchief, double-button jacket and tied apron distinguish the full standing chef, with the platter supported by both hands.

items.title: Open Picnic Lunchbox Coloring Page
items.alt: An open compartment lunchbox contains triangular sandwiches, apple wedges and spiral wraps beside a bottle and spoon in black outline.
items.description: The upright lid, front clasp and separate food sections keep the picnic graphic easy to recognize and color.
